patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I'm fine, I just had a few. Okay, more than a few. Buddies dropped me off. I'm not hurt anywhere — I can walk, I just need to sleep it off, honestly.
presentation.triageNote: 42-year-old male brought by friends after heavy alcohol use. He is drowsy but conversant, walking without assistance, and protecting his airway; examination shows no evident injury or focal neurological deficit.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because this stable intoxication presentation is expected to require one diagnostic resource for bedside glucose or focused screening, followed by observation.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient is drowsy but conversant, ambulatory, protecting his airway, and without evident trauma or focal neurologic deficit.
clinical.acuityReason: The current airway and examination are reassuring, but intoxication remains a diagnosis of exclusion and requires glucose screening and serial reassessment.
expectedResources: Bedside glucose and focused toxicologic or metabolic screening as indicated
teachingPoints: Occult head injury, hypoglycemia, co-ingestion, infection, and other causes of altered behavior must be considered.
Safe disposition requires improving mental status and a safe plan that does not involve driving.

possibleDiagnoses: Metabolic or traumatic mimic if new findings emerge
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Glucose screening and serial observation would be followed by discharge only after clinical sobriety and a safe transportation plan.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 42-year-old man, disheveled, slouched on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slouched back, relaxed and bleary. Expression: bleary and half-smiling. Clearly visible: a slouched, disheveled, intoxicated posture. No text, no logos.
